# Center on Budget and Policy Priorities

> > Nonpartisan research and policy analysis on federal and state budgets, taxes, health policy, and poverty reduction.

The Center on Budget and Policy Priorities (CBPP) is a research organization focused on fiscal policy, budget analysis, and evidence-based policy recommendations. The site covers federal tax policy, government spending, healthcare policy including Medicaid and ACA, and economic impacts of proposed legislation.

## Key Topics

- Federal Budget
- Federal Tax Policy
- Health Policy
- Medicaid
- ACA Marketplaces
- Government Spending
- Tariffs
- Policy Analysis
- Balanced Budget Amendment
- Poverty Reduction
- Fiscal Responsibility
- Trump Administration
- State Policy
- Healthcare Reform

## Homepage

- [Center on Budget and Policy Priorities](https://www.cbpp.org/): CBPP homepage: nonpartisan research on federal and state policy, poverty reduction, and fiscal responsibility
